name: Robo Management Workspace
title: Robo Management Workspace for Operations Teams
short_description: Centralize intake, approvals, execution, and KPI visibility for cross-functional operations teams.
outcome_statement: Reduce workflow cycle time and status-chasing overhead while improving on-time delivery across teams.
primary_pain_points: Work is spread across disconnected tools
Managers lack real-time visibility into execution
Service and internal requests are hard to prioritize
measurable_kpis: Manager hours spent on status chasing

workflows_included.name: Procurement Approvals
workflows_included.summary: Automate purchase request routing and approvals with spend thresholds and owner accountability.

workflows_included.name: Intake Routing
workflows_included.summary: Classify and assign internal and customer requests to the right queue based on urgency and capacity.

workflows_included.name: SLA Operations
workflows_included.summary: Track SLA timers, trigger escalations, and resolve blockers before breach windows are missed.

workflows_included.name: KPI Dashboards
workflows_included.summary: Provide leadership dashboards for throughput, response quality, and cross-team execution health.

install_steps: Install package from Robo Meister Store
Connect team communication and calendar tools
Import active tasks, tickets, and owners
Set priority rules and escalation thresholds
Start weekly management rhythm with KPI dashboard
pricing_hint: Designed for fast-moving operations teams that need cross-functional execution control.
